risks.title: Massive technology integration post-HSBC acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned as 'technology feat' of integrating 800k customers and 100+ branches in one weekend. Central position in CEO letter (inflection point). Intensive language ('once-in-a-generation'). Trend: new operational execution risk. High weight: transformational acquisition.

risks.title: Growing dependence on generative AI and implementation risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned 9 times in text with emphasis on 'safe and secure exploration' and 'full potential'. Top-3 global AI maturity ranking (Evident Index). Cautious language ('safely and securely') suggests risk awareness. Trend: rising (3rd consecutive year in top-3). Strategic weight: key differentiation via RBC Borealis and NOMI.

risks.title: Intensifying North American banking competition
risks.score_rationale: RBC positioned against 'some of the world's largest players' in capital markets (9th US investment bank). Repeated competitive language ('bank of choice', 'differentiated'). Trend: stable but intensified by HSBC acquisition. Weight: RBC must defend Canadian leadership and grow in US against JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, etc.

risks.title: Multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Operations in 30 countries with major presence in Canada, US, UK/Europe. Explicit mention of 'expectations placed on it by regulators'. Governance language (Board oversight). Trend: stable but complexified by HSBC expansion. Weight: strict banking regulation post-2008, stress tests, capital requirements.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and large-scale customer data protection
risks.score_rationale: 18+ million customers, 98,000+ employees, sensitive multi-jurisdictional data. No explicit cybersecurity mention in excerpt, but critical implicit risk for a bank of this scale. Trend: rising (high-value targets). Weight: regulatory (PIPEDA, GDPR, GLBA) and major reputational impact.

risks.title: Key talent retention dependence post-acquisition
risks.score_rationale: Integration of 4,000+ HSBC employees, leadership changes ('new generation of talent'), focus on 'executive development'. Positive language but reveals underlying risk. Trend: rising (post-M&A). Weight: critical talent in wealth management, capital markets and technology.

risks.title: Credit risk and sector concentration post-HSBC
risks.score_rationale: Credit portfolio expansion via HSBC (800k customers). Mention of 'tripling lending to renewable energy' (2030 goal). Cautious language on 'disciplined approach to risk'. Trend: rising (credit expansion). Weight: diversified credit portfolio but exposed to economic cycles.

risks.title: Reputational risks linked to ESG and climate commitments
risks.score_rationale: Commitment of $2B in community investments by 2035, net-zero targets, renewable energy financing. Ambitious language but risk of underdelivery. Trend: rising (stakeholder expectations). Weight: major brand value (Most Valuable Canadian Brand 6 consecutive years).
